reasons.why: The profile is 100% 'other' class (music metadata files, no code, prose, or binary share), so no built-in strategy fits by profile. A custom strategy needs a tune measure showing a built-in loses, and none does: default, conversation, media-metadata and records all score 0.993 (n 428, se 0.004). The strategy stays the code default, which sets nothing.

No candidate beats the default. Three are identical at 0.993. weights-body-heavy is lower at 0.986, a drop of 0.007 that is under two standard errors (0.0114), so it is noise but points the wrong way. Keep every setting at its default. Build keys and semantic mode stay unset: passages are already 4146 chars at p50 and under 6000 at p99. The entities step is not used: no prose dominates and it would cost model calls.
